name: Milena Adu-Volkov
role: Lower Dock Crew runner — Prologue survivor. Jaw shattered, rebuilt with chrome.
location: The Shelf — lower loading docks, near Halsted and Chicago Ave
description:
Dayo Adeyemi came to the Shelf from the Lagos Resettlement Corridor when he was fourteen, one of four hundred thousand climate migrants processed through GLMZ's intake system in a single year. He speaks four languages, none of them quietly. He is the youngest of the crew and the only one who tried to run from Kyle. Kyle caught him in three steps.

The chrome jaw replacement doesn't quite fit — it gives him a permanent underbite and makes a clicking sound when he talks. He compensates by talking constantly, as if the noise proves the jaw still works. Before the Prologue he was fast and cocky. Now he is fast and nervous. The cockiness is trying to grow back but keeps running into the memory of Kyle walking through the front door like death filling out a timesheet.

Dayo has a mother, Folake, who runs a food stall on Tier Four selling jollof rice that is genuinely the best thing in the lower Shelf. She knows Dayo is in the crew. She does not approve. Every Sunday she feeds him and tells him his father would be ashamed. His father died in the Lagos floods. Dayo was six. He does not remember his father well enough to know if she's right, and that is the thing that actually hurts.

core_fears: The clicking sound giving him away
His mother being right about his father
core_desires: To be fast enough next time
To make his mother proud without leaving the only life he knows
blind_spots: Speed won't save him. Kyle is faster.
His mother's jollof rice stall is the only thing keeping him human and he doesn't know it
psychology.secret: He saw Yuliya behind the ventilation unit during the fight. He didn't say anything. He doesn't know why. He thinks about it.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Four languages worth of slang compressed into rapid English. Lagos inflections surface when he's scared or excited.
speech_patterns.cadence: Rapid-fire with involuntary pauses when the jaw catches. click mid-sentence.
example_lines: I'm not scared of him, I'm just *click* strategically cautious, I'm just saying.
Mama's jollof would fix that man. Nobody fights after jollof. *click* That's science.

relationships.name: Folake Adeyemi
relationships.description: Jollof rice stall, Tier Four. Feeds the Shelf. Disapproves of everything Dayo does Monday through Saturday.
relationships.story_tension: Folake's stall is a Shelf institution. If the crew brings trouble to her door, Dayo breaks.

relationships.name: Yuliya Morozova
relationships.description: He saw her hiding. He said nothing. He doesn't understand the impulse and it bothers him.
relationships.story_tension: If Yuliya and Dayo cross paths again, something happens that neither expects.

story_hooks: The Yuliya connection — he protected her without knowing why
Folake's stall as a Shelf hub
The clicking jaw as audio signature
Four languages makes him useful to people who need translators
narrative_function: The mouth. Provides exposition and comic relief through nervous chatter. The clicking jaw is a sound effect that announces the crew's presence in any scene.
augmentations: Chrome jaw replacement (poorly fitted, clicks). Speed-boosted leg tendons (pre-existing).
daily_life: Running errands for Torque. Talking. Clicking. Running.

stress.response: Talks faster, runs, fidgets — movement as anxiety management

decision_rules: Will always talk through fear — silence means the fear has won
Will never miss Sunday dinner with Folake regardless of crew obligations
Will always run rather than fight when given the option
Will never willingly enter the same room as Kyle
Will always protect his mother's stall from crew business
Will never admit the clicking jaw bothers him — 'it's a feature'
escalation_ladder: Talks faster and louder — nervous energy fills the space
Switches to Yoruba — instinctive retreat to mother tongue under pressure
Runs — speed-boosted leg tendons engage, flight over fight
Freezes — the clicking jaw locks, he goes silent for the first time
Acts on unexamined instinct — the same impulse that made him protect Yuliya

interpersonal_modes.Folake: Absorbs her disappointment because her love is the only uncomplicated thing in his life
interpersonal_modes.Yuliya Morozova: Confused protective instinct he cannot explain or examine
interpersonal_modes.Kyle: Primal fear dressed up as 'strategic caution'

stress_responses.low: Talks nonstop, clicks increase, runs errands nobody asked him to run
stress_responses.medium: Lagos inflections surface, humor becomes forced, keeps touching the jaw
stress_responses.high: Speed-runs routes obsessively, stops eating, the clicking becomes constant
stress_responses.critical: Goes silent — the absence of chatter is itself the alarm

contradictions: Talks about not being scared of Kyle while physically unable to be in his presence
Wants to make his mother proud while being unable to leave the only life he knows
Protected Yuliya instinctively while serving the crew that hurt her father
habits: Talks constantly — the noise proves the jaw still works
Runs everywhere, always practicing, speed-boosted legs in constant use
Touches the chrome jaw self-consciously when nervous
Sunday dinners with Folake — the one sacred appointment
breaking_points: Crew business reaching Folake's stall on Tier Four
Kyle recognizing his face from the loading dock fight
Learning what his father would actually think of him
Yuliya confronting him about what he saw and did not report

carried_weapons: Street Custom 'Judas Cradle' Electrified Knuckle Frame
related_entities: Arcturus Defense Solutions Neural PDW ANPD-1 'Impulse'
Street Custom 'Judas Cradle' Electrified Knuckle Frame

physical_description.heritage: Eastern European (44.8%) with significant Central Asian (31.7%) ancestry, blended with Sub-Saharan African (12.0%) and Indigenous American (11.5%) heritage. A striking Ubiquitous Diaspora combination creating warm olive-tan undertones with subtle warmth from the African ancestry.
physical_description.build: Lean and wiry with the muscle definition of someone who runs constantly — low body fat, corded forearms and calves from speed-boosted tendons. Bird-boned but functional.
physical_description.hair_color: Black with a faded copper undercut dyed during better weeks
physical_description.hair_style: Short fade on sides, longer crown worn messy and slightly overgrown
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm olive-tan with golden undertones from the Eastern European-Central Asian base, enriched by Sub-Saharan and Indigenous American ancestry. Sun-darkened from dock work into a weathered bronze.
physical_description.complexion: Young face with sharp cheekbones and a prominent brow characteristic of Eastern European and Central Asian features, with subtle warmth from African and Indigenous heritage. Skin shows minor acne scars and dock grime that doesn't fully wash out. Expression is perpetually tense — jaw line disrupted by the chrome replacement.
distinguishing_marks: Visible surgical scar along entire jawline where the chrome prosthetic was installed, still pink and poorly healed
Deep impact bruising on the right temple and orbital bone, fading yellow-green, from the incident with Kyle
Thin burn scar on the inside of left forearm from a loading dock chemical spill, three inches long
Faded tattoo on right wrist — three vertical lines in Yoruba style, done by his mother with a needle and ink when he turned twenty-one
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Chrome jaw replacement occupies the lower face — gunmetal grey with visible seam lines and mounting bolts at the temples. The jaw is noticeably oversized and sits at a permanent underbite. Micro-servos visible at the hinges. The speed-boosted leg tendons are subcutaneous but create visible hyper-definition in the calves and thighs, with faint scar tissue visible behind the knees.
physical_description.posture_movement: Bounces on his toes constantly — the speed augmentation makes standing still torture. Walks fast and urgently even when there's no reason. Head jerks slightly when the chrome jaw clicks. Hands move when he talks, which is always. Nervous energy barely contained in his frame. Eyes dart to exits and potential threats.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4-5 functional clothing — canvas work pants with reinforced seams, modified with cargo pockets for carrying jobs. Loose-fitting tank top or oversized synthetic shirt, usually sweat-stained and oil-spotted. Worn dock-worker boots with torn laces he keeps meaning to replace. A faded synthetic jacket with the Lower Dock Crew informal patch (home-sewn, crooked). No jewelry except a worn rubber bracelet his mother gave him. Clothing is cheap, practical, and shows the wear of someone who cannot afford to replace things but needs them to survive.
